rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof is direct property damage to the home structure covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Wind damage to roof shingles on back porch overhang; four shingles blown off with no water intrusion or structural damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Low-severity claim with active homeowners coverage.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off roof, no water intrusion or other damage
